result.text: Title: Storage management First, the order is read from the automatic order management system.
Then, it's checked if the first product from the order is in stock.
If it's in stock then it's withdrawn from the warehouse.
However, if it's not in stock then it's reordered from the wholesaler.
Note, that if it was necessary to wait more then 10 days for the arrival of the product then a delivery delay penalty is automatically demanded from the wholesaler.

Finally, it's checked if the whole order is ready for shipment.

Give its repeat branch a sequence flow back to the start of the cycle. Do not connect the exit gateway directly to an end event when the outcome requires an action.

When the description says a participant sends requirements, materials, or orders to several separate outside parties, and at least one of those parties returns something the participant later waits for or reacts to: Represent the participant and each separate outside party as its own bpmn:participant pool in one bpmn:collaboration, one pool per distinct party, including when several parties play the same role. Draw a message flow from each sending task to the pool of the party it addresses, and draw a message flow from each returning party to an intermediate message catch event in the participant's pool.
